nodes.question: How do community-based trading of renewable energy tokens contribute to energy supply diversification?
nodes.answer: Community-based trading of renewable energy tokens helps diversify the energy supply and minimizes the risk of supply disruption by promoting decentralized and community-based renewable energy generation.

nodes.question: How do community-based trading of renewable energy tokens promote decentralized energy generation?
nodes.answer: Community-based trading of renewable energy tokens, such as Solaris and NRG coin, promotes decentralized energy generation by enabling local energy producers to trade renewable energy within their communities.
